minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  April 15, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference
Room, 9th floor at 11:31 a.m.

  Members Present: Debbie Crenshaw, Deputy City Treasurer
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk
  Maria E. Heaney, Revenue Manager

  Staff Present:  Toya Ferguson, Finance Department
  Stephanie Maldonado, Parks and Recreation
  Micah Herd, Police Department

1. The minutes of April 08, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. A. Throne Co, Inc. - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $539.81. Funds to be released after all business tax payments
  have been collected. Motion carried unanimously.

3. Pacific Floor Company - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the
  recommended settlement payment of $6,520.00. Motion carried unanimously.

4. Jerry McAlevey - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $3,520.00. Motion carried unanimously.

5. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:45 a.m.

Adjournment
